usedFor: Pitchit holds your pitches, and Microsoft Excel lists each one when “Add Row To Table” runs.

bestTemplate.name: “When a new pitch is created” in Pitchit, then “Add Row To Table” in Microsoft Excel
bestTemplate.why: Every new pitch gets an Excel row, so your team can track pitches in one table.

watchOut: “When a lead's insights are updated” fires on every update, so the same lead can add rows twice.
